property_prediction_surrogate.definition: Cross-validated regression from provided composition descriptor-derived features to synthetic target property.
assumptions: Dataset is a compact synthetic benchmark
Graph connectivity is shared across samples
invariants: Use only information present in the provided dataset file
Report cross-validated metrics rather than only training fit

structure_generation_proxy.definition: Rank candidate lattice-like axis pairs by low anisotropy and near-central mean-axis preference.
assumptions: Two repeated sequences stand in for generated structural coordinates
Candidate score is a heuristic proxy, not a physics-grounded energy
invariants: Preserve source sequences without modifying raw values

autonomous_optimization_proxy.definition: Gradient-based search over bounded temperature-time space on a smooth surrogate objective initialized from provided starting conditions.
assumptions: Objective is synthetic and chosen for demonstration
Bounds and initialization come directly from the dataset
invariants: Save full optimization trajectory and final recommendation
